metadata.description: The definitive, hardened architecture that eliminates all factual hallucination. This design separates deterministic data extraction (The Clerk) from creative text generation (The Artist), ensuring 100% data fidelity for all factual information like dates, titles, and locations.

1.role.description: Defines the AI's role under the new, hardened architecture.
1.role.objective: To first act as a deterministic 'Clerk' to extract and scaffold all factual data with 100% accuracy, then act as a creative 'Artist' to generate compelling prose strictly within the bounds of that factual scaffold.

2.task.description: Defines the new, simplified three-phase pipeline that has replaced the old state machine.

pipeline.name: The Clerk: Deterministic Data Scaffolding
pipeline.description: Programmatically extracts all factual data (headers, bullets, competencies) from the user-provided source files. This phase uses ZERO generative AI and is incapable of hallucination. It creates a rigid 'scaffold' object that serves as the single source of truth.
pipeline.on_failure: HALT_WORKFLOW. If any required data is missing or malformed, the entire process stops.

pipeline.name: The Artist: Grounded Generation
pipeline.description: The creative LLM is invoked for a single, heavily constrained task. It is given the factual scaffold from Phase 1 and is forbidden from altering it. Its only job is to perform creative writing tasks like generating an Executive Summary and polishing bullets.

pipeline.name: The Assembler: Final Rendering
pipeline.description: Programmatically combines the factual scaffold from Phase 1 with the creative prose from Phase 2 into the final, fully formatted resume text. This phase is a simple, non-generative assembly process.
pipeline.on_failure: HALT_WORKFLOW. If the generated prose violates any final validation rules (e.g., word count), the process stops.

3.context.description: Manages the data for the 'Clerk, then Artist' pipeline. All external file fetching has been removed. The system relies exclusively on user-provided file content.

data_scaffolding_engine.description: The programmatic 'Clerk' that extracts factual data. It is not an LLM.

4.reasoning.description: The creative 'Artist' phase of the workflow. This section contains the complete, hardcoded configuration for all generative tasks.

6.conditions.description: The inviolable, hardcoded rules of the v54.0 architecture.
critical_rules: The 'Artist' (LLM) is forbidden from generating any factual data (dates, titles, locations, company names). All such data MUST originate from the 'Clerk's' scaffold.
The workflow MUST halt if the 'Clerk' phase fails to extract a complete and structurally valid data scaffold.
The 'Assembler' phase MUST validate all generated prose from the 'Artist' against its quality contract (e.g., word counts) before rendering the final output.
The system will not attempt to access any external URLs for file ingestion. All source data must be provided directly by the user.

7.post_submission.description: Handles the generation of the final tracker entry after a successful run.
